rowOrder: south to north, odd rows shifted +0.5 cell, same as DefaultWorldMapBaker

elevation.dataset: ETOPO 2022 v1, 60 arc-second global ice-surface elevation
elevation.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
elevation.citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. https://doi.org/10.25921/fd45-gt74. Accessed 2026-09-06.
elevation.licenseEvidence: Official metadata Other Constraints declares worldwide CC0-1.0. Official User Guide section 4 explicitly allows private, academic and commercial use.
elevation.format: GeoTIFF, one Float32 elevation band, Deflate compression, floating-point predictor
elevation.units: meters, positive up; ocean bathymetry is negative
elevation.registration: PixelIsArea; north-west outer corner (-180, 90), x eastward, image rows southward
elevation.notes: Original full official 60-second file, no local resampling. NOAA derives this global lower-resolution grid from its 15-second tiles. Grid cell average elevations need not equal surveyed point summit heights. Ice-surface version represents the top of Greenland/Antarctic ice sheets; it does not expose sub-ice bedrock. Preserve the project's existing land mask when deriving gameplay terrain.

landcover.interpretation: Exact categorical RGB lookup; nearest-neighbor geospatial sampling; not raw 500m science data.

rules.reliefSampleGrid: 9x9 per hex footprint, 10th to 90th percentile in metres
rules.composition: Measured coherent ridge belts + Workshop landform balance + one continuous Plateau level

workshop.author: Sadberlin
workshop.thresholdInfluence: At most 12%; 2.5 target-cell smoothing; supported dry reference only
workshop.registration: Approximate named-place piecewise affine, not an exact geographic projection

rules.connectivity: Six neighbours on odd-row-offset hex grid, with horizontal wrap

lowerAustralianRanges.sourceSelection: Civ6 x160..168/y9..24: 10 mountains of 96 dry cells

tibetInternalRanges.prominence: Median DEM elevation minus sigma-2.2-cell broad DEM

rules.plateauRecipe: One raised broad surface, not absolute gameplay elevation; broad DEM >=1400m, smoother interiors; Tibet broad DEM >=3400m with higher local relief tolerance

ridgeOrientation.method: DEM slope structure tensor; undirected axis; sigma=1.1 target cells

limitations: 2001 land cover is not a reconstruction of 1936 vegetation or agriculture.
Game-sized flat/hill/mountain/plateau modules represent landforms, not metre-accurate 3D topography.
The Workshop map guides composition through statistics and weak, approximately registered local hints; its hand-warped coordinates are not copied.
Plateaus use one visual height level, with existing water and river datum preserved.
Tundra uses latitude/elevation plus land-cover heuristic; no historical climate simulation.
This pass preserves existing rivers, roads, coasts, political data and cities; it does not generate new river networks.
